exposure: administration mode (continuous nocturnal infusion versus daytime bolus)
cohort: The study included 149 pediatric patients aged 2 months to 17 years from two French tertiary care hospitals who received home enteral nutrition between 2009 and 2022.
finding: Enteral nutrition, despite increasing total energy intake, does not significantly alter oral feeding during the first year of administration, with oral intake remaining stable over time.
